verdict.rationale: Fly.io alludes to a stable programmatic API ('The API you start with is the API you keep' – fly-io-docs-15) and ships a well-documented CLI (fly-io-probe-4), but the evidence pack shows no discoverable public API reference or OpenAPI spec (fly-io-probe-3 returns 404s for all candidate API-doc paths, and docs.md also 404s per fly-io-probe-2). This suggests programmatic access exists but is not clearly documented in a machine-readable, publicly accessible way. Missing for 10: a working OpenAPI/API reference link, explicit API documentation pages, and independent confirmation that AI agents can call the API directly rather than through flyctl.
